detail.longDescription:
A business application has three load-bearing parts: a data store, a policy engine and an interface.  The agentic operating model keeps the first two and retires the third, and the value moves with the change.

The context plane now concentrates the sensitive asset: who someone is, what they may do, what they owe and what has happened before, all under one owner and one jurisdiction.  A context layer that cannot be inspected becomes a surveillance asset with a helpful interface.  Whoever holds that layer can steer what the agents do.

https://altlibre.com/blog/context-aid-operating-model-behind-agentic-ai
